description: Elevate your traditional wardrobe with this stunning handcrafted Indian temple jewellery set from MITHRAS CANADA. This exquisite set features an intricately detailed gold-tone pendant showcasing a beautifully sculpted deity motif, adorned with sparkling crystal accents and a vibrant ruby-red stone at its centre. The pendant is suspended from a delicate white pearl bead chain, adding an air of timeless elegance. Matching stud earrings complete the look, each featuring the same intricate deity design framed by shimmering crystals. Lightweight and comfortable to wear, this set is the perfect statement piece for weddings, festivals, cultural celebrations, and other special occasions. It also makes a thoughtful and cherished gift for Diwali, Navaratri, Pongal, or any meaningful milestone. Whether paired with a saree, salwar kameez, or lehenga, this temple jewellery set is sure to make you the centre of attention.
